source: Virtual Fly Brain VFBquery HTTP API (https://v3-cached.virtualflybrain.org/), FlyWire FAFB v783 connectome; class-aggregated connectivity, edge weight = total synapse count

behavior.text: Circadian time: the LNv pacemaker neurons broadcast pigment-dispersing factor (PDF) to clock-to-clock targets (pacemaker neurons, DN period neurons), the accessory medulla hub, and output regions (superior lateral protocerebrum, visual neuropils), gating daily rhythms of sleep, feeding, and courtship.
behavior.basis: LNv as the PDF master pacemaker is textbook Drosophila (Renn et al 1999; Helfrich-Forster); edges below are the resolved API walk, stated as measured wiring

fly_narration: Dawn, dusk — the wheel turns on time.
honest_note: Hop-0 = general LNv class FBbt_00004046 (657 grouped rows, first try). The specific subclasses s-LNv Pdf (FBbt_00003764) and l-LNv (FBbt_00003763) returned 0 rows in every query form (grouped id/label, named) — genuinely empty, not truncated — so the walk uses the general class where the indexed connectivity lives. Hop-1 weights are deduped sums per FBbt id (raw rows carry per-dataset duplicates); paired identical-weight classes (pacemaker/adult pacemaker, SLPpl1/DPLl1) treated as duplicated tiers, most specific member kept. CIRCUIT VS OSCILLATOR: every edge here is REAL measured wiring of the LNv output chain. The OSCILLATOR DYNAMICS — the 24h molecular clock, PDF cycling, phase — are the genuinely unmapped frontier; no API holds them, and nothing here models them.
